title: Baby Player Tweaks+
description: Adds a simple & lightweight compatibility layer between a few mods.
body:
## **Baby Player Tweaks+**

![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/2l5crCc8?logoColor=54ff5d&label=Modrinth&labelColor=54ff5d&color=54ff5d&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fmod%2Fbaby-player-tweaks%2B)
![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1556539?label=CurseForge&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.curseforge.com%2Fminecraft%2Fmc-mods%2Fbaby-player-tweaks-plus)


_**Baby Player Tweaks+** Adds a compatibility layer between **[Baby Players](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/baby-players)** & **[Timeless and Classics: Zero](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/timeless-and-classics-zero),** **[Wildfire's Female Gender Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/female-gender-neoforge)**! There are also plans to add more compatibility between other mods. You can view them down below, where the current compatibility roadmap is!_


_**Notice: I had help making this mod a reality from a friend. I'll list them as a contributor once they make an account!**_

 

## **Why was this made?**

_Well, originally, this is a dumb story. I was playing the **[Baby Players](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/baby-players)** Mod recently & it really annoyed me when the **[Timeless and Classics: Zero Guns](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/timeless-and-classics-zero)** were floating in mid-air, the ears, tail, snout, and claws from the **[Ears](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ears)** mod were not positioned, and were floating in mid-air & the **[Female Gender Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/female-gender-neoforge)** was still visible despite being a baby player model... Then it hit me, why not just fix these inconsistencies & then **BOOM!** This mod idea came along, now here we are!_

 

## **Compatibility Roadmap:**

*   _**[Timeless and Classics Zero](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/timeless-and-classics-zero) - Completed.🟢**_
*   **[Wildfire's Female Gender Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/female-gender-neoforge)** **_\- Completed.🟢_**
*   **_[Ears](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ears) - Partially completed, currently working on it.🟡_**
*   **_[Curios API (Forge/NeoForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios) - Not implemented.🔴_**
*   **_[Trinkets (Fabric)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/trinkets) - Not implemented yet.🔴_**
*   **_[Accessories](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/accessories) - Not implemented yet.🔴_**
